messages:
Sophie (Account Ops): Heads-up — Aventis Health (acct AVT-993) just hit multiple payment failures across methods. CC attempt returned 'do_not_honor', ACH microdeposit verification shows mismatch. Need ops + finance plan.

billing-bot: [event] charge.failed id=ch_1A2b3C amount=12480 currency=usd code=card_declined decline_reason=do_not_honor gateway=stripe ts=2013456790

Jules (Support): I called the customer, they say procurement tried a corporate card and bank flagged it for unusual activity. They haven't completed microdeposit verification — says amounts don't match. Customer asked for wire details as backup.

Maya (Finance): Okay — two parallel tracks: 1) attempt auth-retry for the CC on file (with customer consent), 2) provide secure ACH link and manual wire as fallback. Suggest retry schedule: immediate soft-retry, then 12h, then 48h. If all fail, issue manual invoice and accept wire.

Noah (Billing): I can queue soft-retries via Stripe: set payment_intent.retry with attempt windows. Will hold on final charge until Sales signs off on manual collection terms. Will also generate an AdHoc invoice.

Sophie (Account Ops): @Andre can you confirm whether Sales will accept a one-time manual collection clause (net 3 + late fee waiver) for this account? They are a pilot customer, want to avoid churn.

Andre (Sales): I'm fine with a one-time manual collection and waiving the late fee if they complete verification within 7 days. Please include statement: "Payment accepted via wire or verified ACH; failure to remit will result in suspension." I approve manual collect. :white_check_mark:

Maya (Finance): Good — action items below. I'll prepare wire instructions in a secure doc and send via encrypted email. Suggested retry params: 
- immediate soft-retry (no capture)
- 12h retry (attempt capture up to $12,480)
- final 48h retry and if still failing, mark invoice as 'manual-collect' and email wire instructions.

Noah (Billing): Drafting the invoice note now. Also checking why microdeposit matched failed — sample log: 
```
ACH verify failed for acct AVT-993: expected [0.12,0.35] received [0.11,0.35] -> mismatch_code=MDM01
```
If customer confirms small difference we can re-trigger verification.

Jules (Support): Customer says they only entered one of the two amounts (they missed the second deposit). Asked for a resend. I'll push them to complete verification and send the secure ACH link.

Maya (Finance): Wire instructions (placeholder summary — full details via secure doc/email):
- Beneficiary: Redwood Inference Inc. (Finance Clearing)
- Bank: Redwood Custodian Bank (US)
- Routing / ABA: [provided in secure doc]
- Account: [provided in secure doc]
- Reference: AVT-993 invoice 4572
Note: Must confirm IBAN/ABA before initiating.

Sophie (Account Ops): I'll attach the secure ACH link to the support thread and note Sales approval. @Noah please add the manual collect flag to the invoice and set SLA hold so we don't auto-suspend before 7 days.

Noah (Billing): Done: invoice 4572 -> flags: [manual_collect, sales_approved, hold_7d] ; retry schedule queued. :thumbsup:

billing-bot: [event] invoice.updated id=inv_4572 status=manual_collect flags=[manual_collect,sales_approved,hold_7d] ts=2013456820

Maya (Finance): I'll send the encrypted wire instructions to the procurement contact and cc Sophie. Please confirm once they confirm payment method so we can close the ticket.

Jules (Support): Customer confirmed they will re-check microdeposits and try CC retry if we trigger it. I'll log follow-ups at 12h and 48h.

Sophie (Account Ops): Summary of next steps: 1) Noah trigger soft-retry now + schedule 12h/48h; 2) Jules resend ACH secure link; 3) Maya send wire instructions encrypted; 4) Andre approved manual collect terms; 5) Close or escalate after 72h. Thanks everyone. :pray:
